# Two handlers whose names differ only in case produce the same exported
# TemplateRoutePaths method; the error lists where each is defined.

! muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Error:
TemplateRoutePaths method name collision: handlers "list" and "List" both produce method "List"
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:11: "list" is defined here
$WORK/template.gohtml:2:11: "List" is defined here
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /items list(ctx)"}}a{{end}}
{{define "GET /items/{id} List(ctx, id)"}}b{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) list(_ context.Context) string             { return "" }
func (T) List(_ context.Context, _ string) string   { return "" }
